rows.note: This is the everyday noun for a haircut or haircut touch-up.

example.english: I’m going for a trim today; I’m only taking a little off.
example.traditional: 我今日去剪髮，淨係修短少少。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 zin2 faat3 zing6 hai6 sau1 dyun2 siu2 siu2

rows.note: Use this for decorative material or detailing placed along an edge or border.

example.english: This skirt has a bit of trim added, so it looks much more delicate.
example.traditional: 呢條裙加咗少少飾邊，睇落精緻好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 kwan4 gaa1 zo2 siu2 siu2 sik1 bin1 tai2 lok6 zing1 zi3 hou2 do1

rows.note: In automotive contexts, this means the equipment and established feature configuration of a vehicle version.

example.english: This trim level is better equipped; it even has a sunroof.
example.traditional: 呢個版本嘅配置齊啲，連天窗都有。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 baan2 bun2 ge3 pui3 zi3 cai4 di1 lin4 tin1 coeng1 dou1 jau5
